title: Confirmation statement for a Scottish limited partnership (SLP CS01)
text:
How to send your form to us

 • 
 Complete your form.

 • 
 Save your completed form to your device.

 • 
 Upload your document to Companies House - it costs £110 to file (you can pay the fee in the service by debit or credit card).

 Use this service to file certain documents online instead of posting a paper form. It usually takes much longer to process paper documents sent by post.
